metadata.title: Independent Reproduction of η_CP Polarization Purity Claim for Chiral Diode Variant
metadata.environment: Debian 13, Elmer FEM 9.0 built from source with gfortran 13.4 (no MPI)

radial_sweep.note: No mesh points at this radius

concordance_analysis.interpretation: Independent reproduction confirms LHCP helicity (s3 > 0) and IEEE CP PASS (AR <= 3 dB), but does NOT reproduce the claimed ultra-high purity of eta_CP = 99.98% / AR = 0.15 dB. Measured values are 70.28% / 1.83 dB. The raw FEM nodal output yields eta_CP = 70.28% (mean per-point 77.01%, peak 97.65%), which already satisfies IEEE criteria (AR <= 3.0 dB), while 99.98% represents the idealized theoretical mode synthesis target under exact 3rd-harmonic chirped quadrature compensation and spatial mode filtering.

verdict: PARTIAL REPRODUCTION — helicity (LHCP) and IEEE pass (AR <= 3 dB) confirmed; raw FEM nodal integration yields 70.28% (peak 97.65%), while 99.98% represents the compensated analytical harmonic design target.
